lines: The restaurant was a bit of an institution in this city of darkness.
One couldn't call it luxurious by any means, but the work was diligent, and offered the kind of cooking that resonated with the heart and soul.
The portions were large, yet the prices were reasonable, so it had become an oasis for young, cash-strapped mercenaries and hoodlums.
It was to the point where there were even stories about how members of organizations that were currently in conflict would stop fighting in this café.
However, nowadays, even that――
Library
「Excuse me. Are you open?」
Jerking open the poorly-constructed antique door, a man entered the restaurant.
He had a steel mask, and the movements of his cyborgized limbs were as smooth as a leopard's.
Taimanin Library.

He was a cyborg Taimanin who had once served Danjou, the previous head of the Fuuma clan, under the name Sagou Bungo, but who, for certain reasons, had changed his name and appearance, and now worked under the
heir to the family, Fuuma Kotarou.
Employee
「Ah! Um...... Could it be that you're, like, a customer......?」
Library
「? Indeed so. I just so happened to be passing through here on my holiday, so I stopped by...... Is that an issue?」
Employee
「N-No, no......! Anyway, this way, please......!」
A thuggish employee, who was clearly unaccustomed to serving customers, showed Library to a seat.
Library
While cocking his head in confusion and wondering “What could be the meaning of this?”, Library ordered his food.
This restaurant was an establishment that he had frequented often in his youth――when he was still flesh and blood.
A popular restaurant, referred to as a hidden attraction of the dark city of Senzaki.
Since it tasted good, yet was both cheap and substantial in quantity, it was cherished by everyone from local poor people to mercenary bands.
He had happened to be passing by, then suddenly felt nostalgic and decided to drop in, but......
Library
Even though it was lunchtime, there were no customers.
The one and only person was a young, blonde man, slurping ramen at the end of the counter.
When he peeked briefly into the kitchen, a young woman was wielding a wok with a grim expression.
Library
（Hmm......? I see no sign of the owner, either......）
Employee
「Uh...... Sorry to keep ya waitin'. Here's the crab fried rice and the fried bean sprouts you ordered!」
Library
「Ah, thank you.」
While he was thinking things like that, his meal arrived.
Sense of taste was one of the few human functions that remained in him.
Ordinarily, he procured nourishment from food specialized for cyborgs, but he was also able to ingest regular food.
Kotarou
『Library works too hard, so how about taking a break every once in a while?』

When his master, who was concerned about him, had gifted him a few days off, what had suddenly popped into his head was the taste of the cooking of this restaurant, which he had frequented in his youth.
However――
Library
「Mmh?! This isn't......」
The taste was different from before.
Perhaps because the heat of the pan wasn't high enough, the Chinese fried rice was sticking together, and the flavour of the crab was lifeless.
As for the stir-fried bean sprouts, there was an unevenness to the salting, giving it a harsh taste in some ways.
Library
（This is...... pretty hard to describe.）
It wasn't so poor that he would raise his voice to complain that it tasted bad.
Having said that, it was an obvious amateur job, completely different from the last proprietor.
Woman
「U-Um......? Was my cooking just now still not any good......?」
Library
「Who are you......?」
A woman with an apologetic-looking face stood in front of Library.
The woman who had been stirring the wok in the kitchen――In other words, the one who had made this meal.
Erika
「I'm...... called Erika, and I'm looking after this café because of a little situation.」
Erika
「I'm in training to do cooking right now...... I'm wondering if maybe I didn't make it taste very good?」
Library
「In training?」
Erika
「Right. So, if it's not good cooking, I figure it'd be wrong to take money from Customer-san......」
Erika
「Well, the recipe itself I learned from the old man who runs the place, so I'm sure it's bang on.」
Erika
「But I've barely made any food before.」
Employee
「Anego...... If you're gonna say that kinda stuff, you shouldn't serve it to the customers in the first place, though.」
Erika
「Sh-Shut up! Then it wouldn't be training, would it?!」
Library
He didn't really understand the situation, but it looked like the owner of this popular restaurant wasn't here after all.
Library
「Certainly, the flavour does seem a little different from that of the old man who was here before. Whatever happened to him?」
Erika
「Eh? You know him, Customer-san?」
Erika tilted her head questioningly, at which point the restaurant door opened with a clatter.
Man
「My, the café's customer-free as ever! How nice and quiet it is.」
Library
It was a businessmanlike fellow wearing an expensive suit.
He entered the restaurant with a sneering smile affixed to his cheeks, accompanied by black-suited men who appeared to be his bodyguards.
Erika
「――Kanou!! What is it?! What did you come here for?!!!」
Kanou
「That's a fine way to greet someone. Even though there's no one who loves this café more than me...」
Erika
「That's bullshit. The old man's been going through a hard time thanks to you.」
Kanou
「Haha, that's a separate matter. I'm just doing my job too, after all, you see?」
There was no sign of him being perturbed by the ferocious look from Erika, who seemed to be snapping at him.
The man she had called Kanou looked all around the inside of the restaurant, still making a mocking smile.
Kanou
「The same goes for my business here. A warning. No, advice?」
Erika
「Advice??」
Kanou
「No matter how much some incompetents practice, it'll be no use. How about you pull out, before you're embarrassed?」
Erika
「?! D-Don't go screwin' with me! We won't know that unless we try, will we?!!!」
Kanou
「Actually, I do know.」
Kanou
「It would appear that a gourmet, the famous fine young lady of the Francis Family, will also be participating in this event.」
Kanou
「This café does appear to be loved by the poor people who live in these parts, but...... to put it the other way round, that means it's only on that level.」
Kanou
「Even if the owner were in good health, winning this event would be...... Kukuku.」
Erika
「Don't you look down on the old man's store!! ――Hey, Yasu, fetch the salt!! We're gonna kick these people out!!」(TL: Salt is used in ceremonial exorcisms to cleanse places of evil spirits.)
Employee
「S-Sure thing, Anego......!」
In response to Erika's sharp exhortation, the hoodlum employee was about to step forward――
But hesitated due to the intimidating air of the bodyguards Kanou had brought along.
Kanou
「Hahaha!! Well, then, we'll take our leave. Do be sure not to forget the agreement.」
Kanou
「If you lose, you hand over the café immediately――I'm looking forward to it, you know?」
The man laughed triumphantly, and left the restaurant with his guards and entourage in tow.
Erika
「Ahhh～, I'm pissed! He's a really nasty son of a bitch!」
Erika
「......Um, sorry, Customer-san. Showing you such a strange scene...」
Library
「No, I don't mind, but...... What on earth was the meaning of that just now?」
Library inquired, at which point Erika hesitated with a troubled-looking expression.
Erika
「N-Nothing really. It's nothing to do with Customer-san......」
Library
「Perhaps so. But I too have been a regular at this place before, you see.」
Library
「So after seeing that scene just now, I cannot help but become concerned――」
「Well, not like it's gonna get much worse, so ya might as well tell him, right?」
「Y'see, Mr. Cyborg, this stupid girl's a busybody, pokin' her nose into a fight she can't win.」
Erika
「H-Hey, Juubei?! Don't butt in with anything uncalled-for!!」
Library
（Juubei......?）
The one who had called out to him was the young, blonde man who was slurping his ramen at the end of the counter.
A rather flashy, flippant-looking appearance.
Yet in his eyes there was no negligence, but the telltale sinister look of a person in a shady occupation.
Juubei
「Haah, shuddup, won'tcha? I'm tellin' him what you wanna tell him. ――So, Cyborg Man.」
Juubei
「I'm called Juubei. I live around here——You wanna know about this restaurant, right?」
Library
「Yes, if you don't mind me asking.」
Library nodded. That name rang a bell――But right now, he was “on vacation”.
At the moment, this restaurant's circumstances interested him more than the man's identity.
Juubei
「Well, it's a story that anyone in the know would know. Basically, it's money――Well, that's a run-of-the-mill kinda situation.」
Library
Juubei
「Yeah. There's a quote-unquote “debt”.」
――Juubei's story was as follows.
The root cause of this was that, at some point, customer traffic had died off.
Struggling to run the place, the restaurant's owner borrowed some money.
The one who lent that money was Kanou, that businessmanlike man who had come to the café just now.
Juubei
「――This area is the “tastiest” site in Senzaki, as it's undergoing redevelopment. The guy must've had his eye on it for a long time.」
And so, when the owner of the restaurant fell behind in repayment, Kanou pressured him to sell it off.
However, the owner refused that.
He said that the restaurant had formed a little community in this city of darkness, and it would distress a lot of people if it were to go under――
Juubei
「So, as a final ultimatum, the old man here begged that guy, 『Please gimme until the civic event at the end of the month!』」
This time every year, an event took place in Senzaki under the auspices of the Shopkeepers' Association.
A cooking contest was held there by volunteers, and the owner had had several experiences of winning it.
If he were to get a result there once again, the customers who had stopped coming would return, the owner thought.
If customer traffic returned to the store, there would be hope of being able to repay the debt.
However, if the outcome of the contest wasn't so good――
Library
「He forfeits the store immediately, hmm?」
Kanou, who had come by a moment ago, had left the restaurant saying that.
Juubei
「Yeah. Seems that's how the negotiations ended up, and he was even forced to sign a written agreement.」
Erika
At any rate, his hopes depended on it.
Even though customer traffic had dwindled, this restaurant had once been well-known.
If he could just serve his food in a place where it would be evaluated... ――Thinking that, the owner had regained his determination, when an unexpected misfortune occurred.
Erika
「The old man had an accident.」
Library
「Accident?」
Erika
「......He fell down the station stairs and went to the hospital. Fractured his arms and hips. They say it'll take two months to recover completely.」
Because of this, he couldn't make food.
It would also be hopeless to participate in the contest――At that point, one of the café's regular customers volunteered.
Female mercenary Erika Blackmore.
She and her fellow mercenaries had always been well taken care of by this restaurant. And so――
『I'll do it in your place. I'll make you win for sure!』――
Juubei
「――She said, and, well, that's how this wild ape ended up sticking her nose in.」
Juubei finished.
It seemed that he was also a regular customer of the place, and an old acquaintance of Erika's.
Erika
「Huh? Who's the ape?! Blabbing on and on to some random person――You flashy blonde monkey!」
Juubei
「Hey!」
Erika
「What?!」
Yasu
「N-Now, now, both of you, calm down, calm down......!」
The hoodlum-looking employee who had been called Yasu nervously pacified the two of them.
It looked like he, too, was originally not an employee, but Erika's fellow mercenary and assistant.
Erika
「Anyway, that's the situation. Is the Customer-san satisfied, now that he's heard that?」
Erika
「I'm busy with cooking practice. I don't care about the payment, so go home already.」
Juubei
「Hahaha! You train for a week, and this is the result, huh?! Your ramen's terrible!」
Erika
「Shuddup!! Like, you're a regular too, right? You mean to tell me you don't feel like doing anything?」
Juubei
「That's 'cuz it's not my style to interfere with legit business.」
Erika
「Then be quiet!」
Was this what they called giving as good as you get? It wasn't easy to tell whether these two were on good terms or bad.
Library
Staring fixedly at Erika and the others, Library thought about this for a while.
Her fingers had a lot of cuts, seemingly having been nicked by kitchen knives, and it was almost painful to look at.
Library
「.........Might I borrow your kitchen?」
Erika
「Huh?」
Library
「I used to frequent this restaurant in my youth.」
Library
「If I could just borrow some ingredients, I wouldn't go so far as to say I'd reproduce the flavour, but I believe I could craft something similar.」
Erika
「W-Wait, what, Customer-san?!!」
Without replying to Erika's confused-sounding voice, Library entered the kitchen.
Right in front of the entrance was the chef's apron that the owner used.
Library slid that on, and took a kitchen knife in hand.
Library
Juubei
「Hey, man?! You can cook?!」
Library
Not replying, he moved his hands.
Just like fighting methods, the skill, once acquired, was not easily forgotten.
Cutting ingredients, boiling them, grilling them, frying them, arranging them on a plate――
With eye-opening skill and dexterity, Library skillfully finished his dish.
Ten minutes later.
Erika
「N-No way...... This is... delicious?!」
Yasu
「A-Awesome!! Customer-san's cooking tastes crazy good!!」
Erika and the others made their eyes light up as they put the meal into their mouths.
Library's cooking was something he had made from whatever was on hand, yet it had a truly exquisite flavour.
Juubei
「Way ta go! I never thought Mr. Cyborg here would have a special skill like this!」
Library
「Thank you. It would appear that my skills have not gone completely rusty yet.」
Library smiled at their reactions.
Having continued to fight in solitude for a long time, the one and only thing he could call a hobby of his was cooking.
Because it also helped to remind him of his happiest days――before he mechanized his body.
Library
「This may seem presumptuous, but might you allow me to help you?」
Library
「I, too, have been helped by this café in the past. I would like to do something if I can.」
Yasu
「Obviously, if you've got this much skill――Could we please, Anego?!」
Erika
「W-Well...... I guess. Your cooking was just a little bit tastier than mine, so......」
Juubei
「Keh keh, a little?」
Erika
「Shut up, Juubei! Anyway, now's the time for us to be using any means necessary. And you were, um......?」
Library
「I am Library. For certain reasons, I'm going by that name now.」
Erika
「? I don't really get it, but Library-san, eh? ――By all means! Please, lend me your strength!」
Yasu
「All right! Now we can win!!」
Perhaps because the tension that had been building up had been relieved, Erika and Yasu's faces had brightened.
Juubei
「Now, hang on, hang on. For sure, this cyborg guy's skill is superb.」
Juubei
「This is a flavour that would even rival the old man here. Any normal year, and we'd probably win with this. But what about this year?」
Erika
「What, Juubei? You getting nasty again?」
Juubei
「This isn't nasty, it's reality. That Kanou guy said earlier, didn't he?」
Juubei
「That a lady from the Francis Family is also gonna participate in this year's event.」
Library
「Francis Family......? If I recall correctly, that would be that burgeoning mafia that have been expanding their influence of late, yes?」
Library had also heard about that organization before.
The head, Francis, was said to originally be an oni from the Demon World.
He had heard that she was an unparalleled lover of alcohol, and had developed such an interest in snacks that paired well with liquor that her eyes had been opened as a gourmet.
It seemed that she employed a large number of master chefs, and even operated a restaurant as a front for the organization.
Juubei
「What's amazing about her restaurant is that they work with ingredients native to Hell.」
Yasu
「Native to Hell?! Is it okay to eat stuff like that?」
Juubei
「Sure. Most things from the Demon World are poisons that cause instant death, but very rarely, there are incredible delicacies.」
Juubei
「I've tried it once, and it was quite something.」
Juubei
「No matter how good your skill may be, I doubt you can compete with dishes native to Hell.」
Library
He had heard tell of this.
Rare foodstuffs originating in the Demon World generally had a striking flavour, and their robustness was different as well.

For instance, it was said that if you simmered the bone marrow of the relatively uncommon Four-Headed Cerberus, you could get a delicious soup with a flavour many times more robust than pork or beef bones.
Erika
「......Say, Juubei. Could we somehow get our hands on some of those ingredients from Hell?」
Yasu
「?! I get it! If we use that Demon World stuff too...!」
Yasu clapped his hands together. But Juubei shook his head with a wry smile.
Juubei
「There's no chance, in this world. You might find the kinda stuff that's commonly available on the market, but......」
Juubei
「For the kind of rare ingredients that would give you that clinching flavour, you'd have to go down to Yomihara, or even from there to the Demon World.」
Library
「......The Demon World, hmm?」
It would probably take five days at the least to get from here to Hell and back.
They had been saying that the event was at the end of the month, so it would be seriously last-moment.
Also, considering that provision and preparation would be necessary before the event, there really wasn't enough time to――
Erika
「......Understood.」
After thinking for a while, Erika nodded.
Erika
「Library-san, can I leave this place to you?」
Library
「What do you mean?」
Erika
「Fufu. I mean, this kind of work's my specialty, not cooking♪」
Erika
「You stay in the café and prepare. Starting now, I'm gonna go to Yomihara――no, even to Hell——and fetch the ingredients.」
That night.
Kanou's office, somewhere in Senzaki.
A gathering was taking place, to which the boss of the Francis Family had been invited.
On the table were numerous dishes, which caused the aroma of their full-bodied sauce to linger in the air.
Luxurious dishes, which made ample use of rarely-seen ingredients native to the Demon World: Cold pasta in Hellish Honeybee sauce, chateaubriand steak of Hellish Anglerbear, etc.
Kanou
「――I see, this is a marvellous flavour! It feels like my mouth is melting!」
Francis
「Right, right? It goes well with booze, too～♪」
Kanou smirked as he shared a table with Francis, who giggled jovially.
The dishes on the table were the goods that the Francis Family planned to serve at the event.
It seemed the contest was as good as decided.
There was no way that guys from a poor restaurant like that could surpass this exquisite taste.
Subordinate
「Director. Could I interrupt a moment?」
Kanou
A subordinate man whispered into Kanou's ear.
According to a surveillance report, Erika had left the café early in the afternoon, and disappeared somewhere at a hurried pace.
Kanou
「Hmm? Did she give up, or does she have some kind of aim......?」
――Two days later.
A forest in the Demon World.
Ancient ruins stood quietly in the depths of it――
Erika
「――Come on, run, Yasu!! If our information's right, our prey is right down here!!」
As expected, Hell was a tough place to traverse.
On the way, their path had been blocked many times by ferocious monsters, and they had used up way too much time getting here.
There was no time to waste anymore.
Yasu
「Y-Yeah!!! B-But...... Anego, are we really going in there?!」
Erika
「What're you saying, now that we've come this far?! Prepare yourself already!!」
While scolding the intimidated Yasu, Erika charged at full speed into the ruins.
The rare target ingredient――the ferocious monster that had taken the lives of numerous ingredient hunters——was almost in front of their eyes.
At the same time―――
Juubei
「Kuku...... That girl's a moron, man. “I don't do jobs that don't make money”――」
Juubei
「She's always talkin' all cocky like that, yet she's desperate over something like this, that isn't gonna make her a yen.」
Juubei spoke to no one in particular, sitting at his usual spot, the end of the counter.
In front of his eyes, Library was silently carrying out preparations for the event in the kitchen, on his own.
Library
Juubei
「I take it the country where that girl was born is poor as shit, see? So, the fact that she couldn't eat stuff was the hardest thing to bear when she was a kid.」
Juubei
「That's why she feels indebted to the old man who runs the place, who let her have meals free of charge. A real softy.」
Library
Library was continuing his work in silence.
The contest would take the form of using a stall to serve his cooking to a large number of people.
From this point on, there would be a lot of things that needed to be prepared.
Juubei
「Speaking of softies, you're the same too, Mr. Cyborg.」
Juubei
「Why're you sticking your neck out, when you're not gonna make a scrap of profit out of this?」
Library
Library didn't answer.
However, in his mind, images of Erika and his dead daughter were overlapping.
If she were alive, Library's daughter would have been about the same age as Erika.
Just like Erika, she too had often made mistakes in cooking, and gotten cuts in her tiny hands――
Library
「......And why does a fellow such as you care about this restaurant?」
Juubei
「Me? Well, just killing time. Watching trouble play out is a hobby of mine.」
Juubei
「'Cuz, like, right in this fetid city of darkness, this is a spot where nothin' but sweet, softy types gather.」
The Demon World again, inside the ruins――
In the depths of the ruins, an enormous shadow was wavering over an altar room.
It was from a gigantic land-dwelling crab, which made its hard shell clatter as it moved around.
It was a Monster Crab, a “Special A Class” hunting risk food ingredient.
Yasu
「Hiiiiiih?!」
Erika
「Hey, Yasu?! Are you okay?!」
Yasu
「D-Don't worry, Anego! I may be leaking piss, but I won't leak any tears!!!」
Erika
「O-Okay......? Somehow, I can't tell whether that's cool or not.」
Despite soaking his crotch in fear, Yasu touted his fighting spirit with a serious look.
Erika
「Anyway――We're definitely gonna bring that thing back! Follow me!!」
Yasu
「Right!!!」
The female mercenary, Erika, and her assistant, Yasu, leapt into the altar room.
The battle with the Monster Crab, a gigantic crab over five metres in total length, had begun.
